issues.where: crop P, center and lower half of the main storm
issues.what: The cloud filaments pinch into a tight circular wrap around a comparatively smooth, horizontally smeared eye. The abrupt change in texture direction makes the storm look like a warped patch.
issues.fix: Rebuild the vortex with continuous curved advection and carry fine cloud structure through the eye and surrounding flow without a pinched center.

issues.where: crops B, C and E, sunlit bands and right-hand surface of the close globe
issues.what: Broad regions are directionally smeared, with bright clouds feathering into streaks and very little crisp detail between them. The close-up reads as an enlarged soft texture.
issues.fix: Restore fine atmospheric structure at the close-up scale, including sharper cloud filaments and small variations across the bands; reduce any broad directional filtering.

issues.where: crops J and K, outer top ring arc
issues.what: The illuminated outer ring resolves to a nearly uniform hairline with a bright rim, giving it the look of a drawn outline against the softer inner bands.
issues.fix: Give the outer band a resolved optical-depth profile with a softer edge and subtle variation across its width.

issues.where: crops V and W, lower-right star field
issues.what: Several brighter stars resolve into soft, slightly stretched colored blobs instead of compact points.
issues.fix: Keep the bright star cores tighter and use a smaller, more restrained halo and color fringe.

issues.where: whole globe disc, worst lower half and centre (crops A, E, P, Q, V, W)
issues.what: the planet surface is a smeared, radially streaked blur, like a motion-blur or swirl filter; no cloud or terrain detail holds up at native size and it reads as airbrushed paint
issues.fix: re-render the globe from a sharp equirectangular texture with real cloud structure and remove any blur or smear pass

issues.where: storm feature right of centre (crop Q)
issues.what: the white cloud ring is a pasted patch: crisp clumped blobs on top of a blurred base, with no shading or blending into the surrounding atmosphere
issues.fix: paint the storm into the same cloud layer and resolution as the rest of the surface, with soft edges and lighting that matches the terminator

issues.where: rings, upper right (crops C, F, L, M)
issues.what: the rings are thin, ghostly, semi-transparent concentric strokes that show only behind the planet and stop at the limb; no near-side arc crosses the disc and they cast no shadow, so they look like a flat overlay
issues.fix: model the rings as a lit 3D annulus with a front arc crossing the globe, density bands, and a shadow on the planet

issues.where: Milky Way band, left and upper right (crops D, G, T, C, F)
issues.what: the galaxy band is oversaturated orange-brown, with blotchy cloud-like clumps and big bright stars packed into it; it looks like a stock texture stamped on, and it reads in front of the rings
issues.fix: tone the band down to a faint, desaturated haze behind the stars and rings with finer dust lanes

issues.where: left end of rings above the limb (crops B, J) and right end at the limb (crops H, Q)
issues.what: the outer ring arc stops dead in empty space above the atmosphere on the left, and on the right the strokes fade into the haze in a pinched point; nothing explains the ring ending
issues.fix: carry the ring geometry through so it meets the limb correctly or passes behind the planet, with occlusion and a planet shadow on the rings

issues.where: ring band across the top (crops B, C, F, G, K, L)
issues.what: the rings are made of uniform, hairline, evenly lit strokes, like a vector overlay, with no particle texture, no change in opacity and no lighting falloff toward the sun
issues.fix: use a ring texture with radial density variation and scatter, lit by the sun's direction and with forward scattering near the glare

issues.where: night side, lower left (crops D, N, S, T)
issues.what: large near-black area with almost no detail and faint blocky banding in the dark gradient
issues.fix: add dither or grain, and faint terminator detail or city/airglow to break up the gradient

issues.where: day-side cloud deck, lower right (crops U, V, W)
issues.what: clouds are soft directional streaks with a uniform painted look; at native size they're blurry and low-detail
issues.fix: use higher-frequency cloud detail with some vertical structure and shadowing

issues.what: faint vertical streaks in the dark sky beside the limb, carried over from the smear on the globe
issues.fix: keep any blur or smear pass off the background star layer
